outcome: Time to cervical dilation of 6 cm
cohort: 91 healthy nulliparous women with term premature rupture of membranes (PROM)
finding: Older maternal age and higher BMI were independently associated with lower induction success rates, longer times to cervical dilation and delivery, and higher rates of caesarean section and episiotomy in women with term PROM undergoing induction of labor with oral misoprostol.
